responsibility: Implements optional beginner-focused naming diagnostics for gm2. Under style-checking mode it detects identifiers whose uppercase form is a reserved word, and it scans global and procedure-local symbols to find identical or case-only-different names across scopes, suppressing duplicates with internal lists and issuing explanatory `M2MetaError` warnings aimed at preventing misleading or keyword-like naming patterns.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation module for the M2Students pair: it performs the actual reserved-word case check, cross-scope identical-name and case-only similarity scans, duplicate-suppression bookkeeping, and warning emission. Unlike `M2Students.def`, it contains the symbol-table traversal and diagnostic logic.
